excluded_prior_work: IndexNow (already submitted once per live site; not repeated)

candidates.name: Internet Archive Save Page Now
candidates.quote: Put a URL into the form , press the button, and we save the page. ... this method only saves a single page , not the whole site.
candidates.reason: Archival service, not a topical discovery directory. The documented anonymous route is a human web form; no published rule found permitting automated GET submission, and a GET /save/ call would be an endpoint side effect not documented on this page. Not used.

candidates.name: Google sitemaps ping endpoint
candidates.quote: Sitemaps ping endpoint is going away ... The sitemaps ping endpoint deprecation is complete. Monday, June 26, 2023
candidates.reason: Official source states the accountless ping route is retired; remaining routes (Search Console) require an account.

candidates.name: Marginalia Search (small independent search engine)
candidates.quote: This information is outdated ... You can expedite the discovery by submitting it here .
candidates.reason: Page self-declares outdated; submission is via a linked web form, not a documented automated GET API. It also notes the crawler is sometimes blocked by CloudFlare-hosted sites (our hosting). FETCH is GET-only; no form POST or bypass attempted. Candidate limit (3) reached; no further fetches.

scope_of_conclusion: Only these three routes under GET-only, accountless constraints. Not a conclusion about distribution generally.
reconsider_when: A founder-authorized webmaster account (Search Console/Bing) or a POST-capable sanctioned submission tool becomes available, or a directory publishes an explicit automated GET submission API.
